# Auto-generated by scripts/gen_cmake.sh from Texture Mesh.vcxproj
# Cross-compile to Windows x64:  cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<repo>/scripts/mingw-toolchain.cmake -S . -B build

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Auto-set MinGW toolchain for Windows cross-compilation if not passed explicitly
if(NOT CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE AND NOT WIN32)
  get_filename_component(_DEFAULT_TOOLCHAIN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../scripts/mingw-toolchain.cmake" ABSOLUTE)
  if(EXISTS "${_DEFAULT_TOOLCHAIN}")
    set(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE "${_DEFAULT_TOOLCHAIN}" CACHE FILEPATH "MinGW toolchain" FORCE)
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
  set_property(CACHE CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS "Debug" "Release" "MinSizeRel" "RelWithDebInfo")
endif()

project(TextureMesh)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_executable(TextureMesh
    "Texture Mesh/main.cpp"
        "Texture Mesh/scenes.h"
        "Texture Mesh/ext_light.h"
        "Texture Mesh/light.h"
        "Texture Mesh/shader.h"
        "Texture Mesh/light_list.h"
        "Texture Mesh/aabb.h"
        "Texture Mesh/camera.h"
        "Texture Mesh/color.h"
        "Texture Mesh/common.h"
        "Texture Mesh/cylinder.h"
        "Texture Mesh/geometry.h"
        "Texture Mesh/hittable.h"
        "Texture Mesh/hittable_list.h"
        "Texture Mesh/instance.h"
        "Texture Mesh/interval.h"
        "Texture Mesh/ray.h"
        "Texture Mesh/mat4.h"
        "Texture Mesh/material.h"
        "Texture Mesh/mesh_bruteforce.h"
        "Texture Mesh/raster.h"
        "Texture Mesh/mesh.h"
        "Texture Mesh/object.h"
        "Texture Mesh/point2.h"
        "Texture Mesh/sphere.h"
        "Texture Mesh/texture.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tiny_obj_loader.h"
        "Texture Mesh/vec3.h"
        "Texture Mesh/point3_list.h"
        "Texture Mesh/vec.h"
        "Texture Mesh/matrix.h"
        "Texture Mesh/spline.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh_arm_double.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh_arm_float.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh_base.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh_x86_double.h"
        "Texture Mesh/tinybvh/tiny_bvh_x86_float.h"
        "Texture Mesh/test_scenes.h"
        "Texture Mesh/short_scenes.h"
)

# Run with Wine when executing on Linux (IDE 'Play' button / CTest)
find_program(WINE_BIN wine)
if(WINE_BIN)
  set_target_properties(TextureMesh PROPERTIES CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR "${WINE_BIN}")
endif()

# Static runtime linking: prevents missing libgcc_s_seh-1.dll and libstdc++-6.dll
target_link_options(TextureMesh PRIVATE -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++)

# src/ on include path: lets shims (ppl.h, etc.) placed here shadow system headers.
target_include_directories(TextureMesh PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_include_directories(TextureMesh PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Texture Mesh")

# SDL2 via mingw-w64 system package
# find_package(SDL2) has no config file in the mingw package; use find_path/find_library instead.
find_path(SDL2_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES SDL.h PATH_SUFFIXES SDL2)
find_library(SDL2_LIB  NAMES SDL2)
find_library(SDL2MAIN_LIB NAMES SDL2main)
if(NOT SDL2_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT SDL2_LIB)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL2 not found — install libsdl2-mingw-dev (Debian/Ubuntu) or equivalent.")
endif()
target_include_directories(TextureMesh PRIVATE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIR})
# --whole-archive ensures SDL2main's WinMain is always linked (ld won't pull it lazily).
target_link_libraries(TextureMesh PRIVATE
    -Wl,--whole-archive ${SDL2MAIN_LIB} -Wl,--no-whole-archive
    ${SDL2_LIB})
find_file(SDL2_DLL NAMES SDL2.dll PATH_SUFFIXES bin)

# SDL2_image — system mingw package or NuGet package under packages/
find_path(SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES SDL_image.h PATH_SUFFIXES SDL2 CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_BOTH)
if(NOT SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR)
  file(GLOB _IMG_INC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/packages/sdl2_image*/build/native/include")
  if(_IMG_INC)
    list(GET _IMG_INC 0 SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR)
  endif()
endif()
find_library(SDL2_IMAGE_LIB NAMES SDL2_image CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_BOTH)
if(NOT SDL2_IMAGE_LIB)
  file(GLOB _IMG_LIB "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/packages/sdl2_image*/build/native/lib/x64/dynamic/SDL2_image.lib")
  if(_IMG_LIB)
    list(GET _IMG_LIB 0 SDL2_IMAGE_LIB)
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT SDL2_IMAGE_LIB)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL2_image not found — install mingw SDL2_image or restore NuGet packages.")
endif()
target_include_directories(TextureMesh PRIVATE ${SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(TextureMesh PRIVATE ${SDL2_IMAGE_LIB})
find_file(SDL2_IMAGE_DLL NAMES SDL2_image.dll PATH_SUFFIXES bin CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_BOTH)
if(NOT SDL2_IMAGE_DLL)
  file(GLOB _IMG_DLL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/packages/sdl2_image.nuget.redist*/build/native/bin/x64/dynamic/SDL2_image.dll")
  if(_IMG_DLL)
    list(GET _IMG_DLL 0 SDL2_IMAGE_DLL)
  endif()
endif()

# OpenMP — needed by the ppl.h shim (concurrency::parallel_for)
find_package(OpenMP)
if(OpenMP_CXX_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(TextureMesh PRIVATE OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
endif()

# Deploy all required runtime DLLs alongside the executable
set(RUNTIME_DLLS "")
if(SDL2_DLL)
  list(APPEND RUNTIME_DLLS "${SDL2_DLL}")
endif()
if(SDL2_IMAGE_DLL)
  list(APPEND RUNTIME_DLLS "${SDL2_IMAGE_DLL}")
  get_filename_component(_SDL2_IMG_DIR "${SDL2_IMAGE_DLL}" DIRECTORY)
  file(GLOB _SDL2_IMG_DEPS "${_SDL2_IMG_DIR}/*.dll")
  list(APPEND RUNTIME_DLLS ${_SDL2_IMG_DEPS})
endif()
foreach(DLL_NAME libgomp-1.dll libwinpthread-1.dll libgcc_s_seh-1.dll libstdc++-6.dll)
  execute_process(
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER} -print-file-name=${DLL_NAME}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE DLL_PATH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
  )
  if(EXISTS "${DLL_PATH}")
    list(APPEND RUNTIME_DLLS "${DLL_PATH}")
  endif()
endforeach()
if(RUNTIME_DLLS)
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES RUNTIME_DLLS)
  add_custom_command(TARGET TextureMesh POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
    ${RUNTIME_DLLS}
    "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:TextureMesh>"
    COMMENT "Deploying runtime DLLs to binary directory"
  )
endif()

# Unit tests target
add_executable(tests
    "tests/main.cpp"
    "tests/spotlight_tests.cpp"
    "tests/coyote_scene_tests.cpp"
    "Texture Mesh/test_scenes.h"
    "Texture Mesh/short_scenes.h"
)

if(WINE_BIN)
  set_target_properties(tests PROPERTIES CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR "${WINE_BIN}")
endif()

target_link_options(tests PRIVATE -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++)
target_include_directories(tests PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_include_directories(tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Texture Mesh")
target_include_directories(tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests")
target_include_directories(tests PRIVATE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIR} ${SDL2_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(tests PRIVATE ${SDL2_LIB} ${SDL2_IMAGE_LIB})
if(OpenMP_CXX_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(tests PRIVATE OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
endif()
